data_window: 2026-08-20 00:00 to 2026-08-22 14:35 Asia/Shanghai. GitHub Search API queries covered `ai agent`, `mcp agent`, `browser agent`, `code agent`, `RAG agent`, `AI workflow`, `voice agent`, and `copilot agent` using created/pushed windows and sort=updated. Raw responses were saved under `/tmp/radar_2026_08_22_*.json`; selected README audits were saved under `/tmp/radar_2026_08_22_readmes/`.
source_summary: git fetch origin succeeded on `main...origin/main`; pre-existing unrelated frontend/deploy worktree changes and the old untracked `data/runs/2026-08-19-lark-message.md` were preserved unstaged. Discovery used unauthenticated GitHub Search API metadata plus selected README raw downloads. No third-party repository was cloned, installed, built, run, browser-tested, desktop-tested, mobile-tested, MCP-handshake-tested, credential-tested, provider-tested, payment-tested, security-scanned or deployed.
trend_observations: Today’s strongest cluster is agent infrastructure becoming productized: native coding-agent CLIs, GitHub-native workflow controls, operator consoles, desktop/browser execution layers, command guardrails, trace-to-test reliability, and local retrieval/memory surfaces. The useful distinction was not star count alone; README evidence for install paths, screenshots, demos, CLI/API/MCP surfaces, Docker/self-host flows and permission boundaries mattered more than broad AI branding.
assumptions: Scores are editorial point-in-time rankings based on GitHub Search API metadata, README evidence, visible product surface, install/build cues, documentation completeness, repository freshness and AI-native workflow depth. Stars/forks are unauthenticated API snapshots, not exact growth deltas. README claims were not independently runtime-verified. Mature infrastructure, framework-only repos, skill catalogs, courses, prompt/resource collections, generated marketing repos and concept-only READMEs were downgraded or skipped.
